newsitem.title: SWEDEN: H&M says may discuss stock split Jan 30.
newsitem.headline: H&M says may discuss stock split Jan 30.

text.p: Swedish fashion retailer Hennes & Mauritz on Tuesday said its board would discuss the possibility of splitting its shares at a meeting on January 30, the day the company releases its fourth quarter results.

This week H&M shares have soared amid market speculation about a split in the company's stocks and ahead of final quarter earnings. On Monday shares rose 55 crowns and by 1030 GMT Tuesday the price had risen 50 to 1,115 crowns.

"To my knowledge (the split) has not been discussed by the board but it will presumably come up for discussion at the board meeting on January 30 considering all the speculation and press reports," H&M's chief economist, Carl-Henric Enhorning, told Reuters.
"If a split is proposed it will most likely be done in connection with a proposal for profit outlined in the end of year report."
